name: Gorgias
task: A help desk, tickets or a shared inbox
summary: Helpdesk built for ecommerce: tickets, automations and an AI agent, priced by volume rather than by seat -- though the entry tier caps you at three users.
best_for: ecommerce support teams with seasonal or spiky volume, where per-agent pricing punishes you for having enough people on a busy week
skip_if: your volume is steady and low: 50 tickets a month is the entry allowance, and below that a shared inbox costs nothing; also skip the AI agent until you know your automated-interaction count, since that is the meter that runs away
honest_knock:
Never priced per agent is a real advantage, but it starts one tier up: the comparison table caps Starter at 3 user seats, and only Basic and above open the inbox to 500. On Basic upwards your whole team can be in there without the bill moving, which is the main reason to choose this over a per-seat helpdesk.

The cost sits on two meters instead, and both bite. Tickets beyond your allowance cost $0.40 each on Starter, $40 per extra 100 on Basic and $36 per 100 on Pro and Advanced, so a bad week costs money rather than attention. And the AI agent -- the thing the homepage leads with -- is a separate $30 a month on the entry plan, which is three times the helpdesk it sits on. So the honest entry price for the product as advertised is $40, not $10.

Count a normal month's tickets and a busy month's, and price both. Then check the AI meter separately: past the included allowance the comparison table charges $1.00 per automated interaction on Starter, $0.90 on Basic and Pro and $0.85 on Advanced (read 7 October 2026). Price your expected volume at that rate before you switch the agent on.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month with the AI Agent included, monthly billing only, as gorgias.com/pricing shows it
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on gorgias.com/pricing and on the App Store listing apps.shopify.com/helpdesk, and in our own test session on 17 November 2026; first read 2026-09-08; gorgias.com/pricing re-read 2026-11-23, unchanged) Four plans with the AI Agent included, as gorgias.com/pricing shows them by default: Starter $40 a month, Basic $90, Pro $550 and Advanced $1,430, or $77, $471 and $1,227 a month billed annually ($924, $5,652 and $14,724 a year); Starter bills monthly only. The helpdesk and the AI Agent are priced separately inside each plan: $10 and $30 on Starter, $60 and $30 on Basic ($50 and $27 annually), $360 and $190 on Pro ($300 and $171) and $900 and $530 on Advanced ($750 and $477). The App Store listing prints only the helpdesk part, Starter $10 a month, Basic $60 or $600 a year, Pro $360 or $3,600 a year and Advanced $900 or $9,000 a year, and shows the AI Agent as an add on, so the listing's $60 Basic is the $90 Basic without the AI Agent. Starter includes 50 tickets and 30 automated interactions, Basic 300 tickets and 30 interactions, Pro 2,000 tickets and 190 interactions and Advanced 5,000 tickets and 530 interactions. It is never priced per agent, in their own words, but the seats are capped: the comparison table gives Starter 3 user seats and Basic, Pro and Advanced 500 each, while the listing calls Basic's agents unlimited and Pro's and Advanced's up to 500. Ticket overage is $0.40 a ticket on Starter; on Basic the listing and the comparison table print $40 per additional 100 tickets, and on Pro and Advanced $36 per 100, which the page's structured data gives as $0.40 and $0.36 a ticket; neither page says whether part of a block of 100 is billed in full. Past the included interactions the comparison table prices the AI Agent at $1.00 an interaction on Starter, $0.90 on Basic and Pro and $0.85 on Advanced; the FAQ in the page's structured data says $0.90 on annual plans and $1.00 on monthly ones, and the same structured data still names $1.50, the rate the plan cards showed on 8 September. Above 5,000 conversations a month it is quote only, and that custom plan lists SSO through SAML, SCIM provisioning and an API at 4 requests a second, where every listed plan gets 2. In our own test session the 7 day trial started on Starter with the AI Agent switched on: the billing screen showed the helpdesk at $10 a month and the AI Agent at $30, both to be billed through Shopify once billing was activated. All listing charges are billed in USD every 30 days, and each plan on the listing has a 7 day free trial.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Gorgias on a Shopify development store: the install, a workspace made by the app on its own with no password or card, one macro with made up text saved in about 1.5 minutes and 5 steps, and the Billing page with a free trial from 17 to 24 November, Starter at $10 a month for 50 tickets and the AI Agent at $30 a month for 30 interactions. The app said Shopify billing was inactive, and Activate in Shopify led to an empty screen, so nothing was approved and the checkout was not tested. Nothing was sent, no channel was connected, and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the App Store listing (English) was opened and the install form was submitted at 18:33 in our own tab. The first screen was Connect your Gorgias account to Shopify, with the choices Create Your Account and Already have an account. Create Your Account led to the Shopify dialog Install app, which asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data; Install was clicked. The app then showed Generating your Gorgias workspace and opened a workspace of the vendor on its own; the address of that workspace contains the name of our development store, so it is not shown. No password, card, phone number or form was asked: the account came from the Shopify identity. A banner said Your account is not verified. Please check your email.; no e-mail was sent or opened. The admin was in English. Core action, one macro (a saved reply): Settings, Macros, Create macro, the name Test: Snowboard shipping delay and the text Hi, thanks for your patience. Your snowboard is packed and leaves our test warehouse tomorrow. This is invented test text., then Create macro. It was done at about 18:34, about 1.5 minutes after the start and 5 steps after the form was opened. The macro appeared in the list with usage count 0; the list already held 12 example macros of the vendor. No mailbox, social channel or phone number was connected and no ticket or message was sent. The AI Agent was not tested. Plans in the app: Billing, Usage & Plans said Your free trial started on November 17, 2026 and will expire on November 24, 2026 (seven days). Helpdesk was Starter at $10/month with 0 of 50 tickets used; AI Agent was $30/month with 0 of 30 automated interactions used; Voice (from $30/month) and SMS (from $20/month) were inactive and locked. Together Starter and the AI Agent are $40 a month, as the dossier says. The Basic plan and above were not looked at in the app. Difference with the dossier (from the listing, not from the app): the listing names Basic at $60 a month or $600 a year, while the dossier gives Basic at $90 a month or $77 a month billed annually. This comes from the listing and is not a test result; Basic was not opened in the app. Checkout: NOT reached. A banner said Your Shopify billing is inactive, so your payments may not go through, and that after activation the Starter plan ($10/month), the AI Agent ($30/month) and Gaia would be billed through Shopify, excluding sales tax. The button Activate in Shopify first opened an extra tab (closed) and, in our own tab, led to the billing activation address of the vendor and stayed on an empty screen of the vendor. The Shopify screen Approve subscription was not reached, nothing was approved, no card was entered and nothing was paid; so the checkout was not tested and no total, tax or test charge text was seen. Cancelling: not tested as a separate step; the app was removed through Settings, Apps, Uninstall (reason: Testing multiple apps) at about 18:37 and Gorgias no longer appeared in the list. Not tested: the AI Agent, live chat, real tickets, Shopify order data in tickets, seats, Basic and higher plans, cancelling inside Gorgias, e-mail verification and the Shopify approval screen. Clean up: the app was uninstalled; the test macro stayed in the workspace of the vendor, which is no longer linked to the store; no plan was approved and no theme change was made; our own tabs were closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The workspace address contains the store name and the app was not verified by e-mail; the Billing page said Shopify billing was inactive and Activate in Shopify led to an empty screen; an extra tab opened first; and the listing gives a different Basic price than the dossier.

open_questions.question: Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?

Our price check could not put a number on this part of the cost: The bill is driven by tickets, not users: each plan includes a ticket allowance (50, 300, 2,000, 5,000); beyond it Starter charges $0.40 a ticket, Basic $40 per additional 100 tickets and Pro and Advanced $36 per 100. Price the plan against your own monthly ticket count. Can you publish the price or the rule?

Our price check could not put a number on this part of the cost: AI Agent interactions over the plan allowance: the comparison table prices them at $1.00 on Starter, $0.90 on Basic and Pro and $0.85 on Advanced, while the page's structured data still names $1.50. Can you publish the price or the rule?
